claim: survivalizeed's ShadowOfWarPacketLoader replaces game resources at load time by hooking the engine's main file-read routine and swapping chunk bytes matched by stored signatures; it is installed as a plugin of the mod loader.
evidence: hook_loading_routines.h defines MAIN_LOADING_ROUTINE_HOOK(File*, outVar, bytes_to_read); README requires MinHook.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN; Nexus page says signatures may need regenerating if replacements fail.
verification_method: Read source at pinned commit. Verify by locating the hooked read routine by pattern in a copied exe (static).
limitations: No license; early-stage tool per its author; approach works around unknown arch06 format rather than documenting it.
next_experiment: Use its File struct field names (source_ptr, file_relative_offset, currently_loaded_size) as hints when reversing the archive reader statically.
